title: Tiny, cute laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/glow under laptop -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#3a2f6e'/>
  <!-- laptop base (keyboard deck) -->
  <path d='M18 68 L82 68 L88 80 L12 80 Z' fill='#8a7fd6'/>
  <path d='M18 68 L82 68 L83 72 L17 72 Z' fill='#b3a8f0'/>
  <!-- keyboard keys row -->
  <rect x='24' y='73' width='52' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#5a4fb0'/>
  <!-- little trackpad -->
  <rect x='42' y='78' width='16' height='2.2' rx='1' fill='#c9bff2'/>
  <!-- screen lid -->
  <path d='M24 30 L76 30 L80 66 L20 66 Z' fill='#6f63c9'/>
  <!-- screen bezel highlight -->
  <path d='M24 30 L76 30 L76.6 34 L23.4 34 Z' fill='#a99cf0'/>
  <!-- glowing screen -->
  <rect x='28' y='35' width='44' height='27' rx='2' fill='#2b2350'/>
  <!-- cute face on screen -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='3' fill='#7ef0d0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='3' fill='#7ef0d0'/>
  <path d='M44 54 Q50 59 56 54' stroke='#7ef0d0' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- screen shine -->
  <path d='M32 37 L38 37 L32 43 Z' fill='#6fe6c8' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- little heart sticker on lid -->
  <path d='M50 27.5 C48.5 25.5 45.5 26.3 45.5 28.6 C45.5 30.6 50 33 50 33 C50 33 54.5 30.6 54.5 28.6 C54.5 26.3 51.5 25.5 50 27.5 Z' fill='#ff7fa8'/>
</svg>
